newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel dividends may start in 2006 - FT.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel dividends may start in 2006 - FT.

text.p: Eurotunnel hopes to pay its first dividend in 2006 if an 8.54 billion stg financial restructuring is approved by its shareholders and bankers, the Financial Times reported on Saturday.
The newspaper said documents to be sent to shareholders of the Channel tunnel operator later this month were expected to show that it hopes to break into profit by 2005 or 2006.
"But analysts say a dividend could be delayed until 2011 if revenues fail to grow as fast as expected," it added.
"Brokers believe the company will have to show its most upbeat projections are credible to persuade its 700,000 investors to back the refinancing."
